programmes.funder: Cradle Fund Sdn Bhd (Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation)
programmes.amount_note: Conditional grant of up to RM150,000 for pre-seed technology startups to build a prototype or minimum viable product and validate the market. Disbursed in milestone-linked tranches over roughly 12 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis through the Cradle online portal, subject to budget availability. Cradle periodically pauses intake when the annual allocation is committed.
programmes.reopen_note: Cradle reopens intake with each new budget allocation. If the portal shows intake closed, monitor cradle.com.my and Cradle's social channels for the next opening.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Cradle online application portal.
Complete the application with the technology description, prototype plan and commercialisation strategy.
Pre-screening by Cradle for eligibility and completeness.
Due diligence and pitch to the evaluation panel.
Approval, signing of the grant agreement, and milestone-based disbursement.

documents_required.doc: SSM company registration documents (Form 9/13/24/49 or Section 14/17/51/58)

eligibility.other_note: Malaysian-incorporated company (Sdn Bhd) with at least 51% Malaysian equity, at least 51% held by the founders, incorporated for not more than three years, and not having received other Cradle funding for the same product. Directors must be Malaysian citizens aged 18 and above.

programmes.source_snippet: CIP Spark provides funding of up to RM150,000 for pre-seed stage technology startups.

programmes.funder: Cradle Fund Sdn Bhd (Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation)
programmes.amount_note: Conditional grant of up to RM600,000 for seed-stage technology startups with a working product, to support commercialisation, market expansion and revenue growth. Milestone-based disbursement, typically over 18 to 24 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling intake through the Cradle portal, subject to annual budget availability.
programmes.reopen_note: Intake reopens with each budget allocation; monitor cradle.com.my when the portal shows intake closed.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Cradle portal and complete the CIP Sprint application.
Pre-screening for eligibility.
Due diligence including product demonstration and financial review.
Pitch to the evaluation panel.
Grant agreement and milestone-based disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Malaysian-incorporated Sdn Bhd with at least 51% Malaysian equity and majority founder ownership, with a commercially ready product and some traction.

programmes.source_snippet: Cradle provides funding, coaching and market access to Malaysian technology startups from pre-seed to seed stage.

programmes.amount_note: Grants supporting the production and commercialisation of Malaysian digital creative content (animation, games, visual effects and related IP). Award size depends on the project scope and is negotiated per approved project.
programmes.deadline_note: Runs in periodic calls tied to MDEC's annual programme budget rather than continuously.
programmes.reopen_note: MDEC restructures its creative content funding periodically. Check mdec.my for the current digital content and creative economy funding calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Monitor MDEC for an open digital content funding call.
Prepare the project proposal with production plan, budget and distribution strategy.
Submit through the MDEC portal.
Evaluation panel review.
Grant agreement and milestone disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Distribution or publishing agreements where available

eligibility.other_note: Malaysian-incorporated companies producing original digital creative content and IP.

programmes.source_snippet: MDEC leads Malaysia's digital economy, including support for the digital creative content industry.

programmes.name_local: Status MSC Malaysia / Malaysia Digital (MD Status)
programmes.amount_note: Not a cash grant. MD Status confers a package of incentives and rights including income tax exemption or reduced rate on qualifying digital activity income (subject to conditions and separate application to MIDA/LHDN), multimedia super corridor style rights such as unrestricted employment of knowledge workers and freedom of ownership, plus duty exemptions on multimedia equipment.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the MDEC online portal. Approval typically takes several weeks to a few months.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the company's activity falls within a Malaysia Digital promoted activity.
Register and apply on the MDEC online application platform.
MDEC assessment of the business plan, technology and knowledge-worker commitments.
Approval and issuance of the MD Status certificate with conditions.
Apply separately for tax incentives where eligible, and comply with annual reporting.

documents_required.doc: Details of intended knowledge workers and technology used

eligibility.other_note: Company incorporated in Malaysia under the Companies Act, proposing to carry out one or more Malaysia Digital promoted activities, with commitments on knowledge workers and, for the tax incentive, on Malaysian ownership and operating expenditure.

programmes.source_snippet: Malaysia Digital status provides companies with a set of rights and incentives to grow their digital business in Malaysia.

programmes.amount_note: TDF1 supports the commercialisation of locally developed R&D from Malaysian universities and research institutes; TDF2 supports the acquisition of foreign technology for local production. Awards have historically run up to several million ringgit depending on the stream, with a company contribution required.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling submissions to MTDC, subject to available allocation from the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.
programmes.reopen_note: MTDC funding streams are re-scoped periodically with government allocations. Confirm the current stream names and available budget with MTDC before preparing a proposal.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact MTDC to confirm the appropriate fund stream and current availability.
Prepare the commercialisation proposal including technology source, market analysis and financial projections.
Submit the application with supporting documents.
Technical and financial due diligence, including site visit.
Approval committee decision, agreement signing and milestone disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Technology transfer or licence agreement with the research institution
Evidence of the company's matching contribution

eligibility.other_note: Malaysian-incorporated companies with at least 51% Malaysian equity commercialising locally developed technology (TDF1) or acquiring foreign technology for local production (TDF2).

programmes.source_snippet: MTDC provides funding and advisory support for the commercialisation of technology in Malaysia.

programmes.funder: Cradle Fund Sdn Bhd on behalf of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation
programmes.amount_note: National single-window platform for Malaysian startups, providing the MyStartup accelerator (cohort-based, with pilot opportunities and investor access), talent matching, and the MyStartup single window for registration and access to government programmes. Cash support comes via linked Cradle grants rather than the platform itself.
programmes.deadline_note: Platform registration is open continuously. The MyStartup Accelerator runs in cohorts with defined application windows.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the startup on the MyStartup single window.
Browse available programmes, accelerators and grants.
Apply to the relevant accelerator cohort or linked funding programme when open.

eligibility.other_note: Malaysian-registered startups. Some programmes are open to foreign founders establishing a Malaysian entity.

programmes.source_snippet: MyStartup is Malaysia's national startup platform, a single window for startups to access programmes and support.

programmes.funder: Penjana Kapital Sdn Bhd (Ministry of Finance Malaysia)
programmes.amount_note: A fund-of-funds matching government capital with private venture capital to invest into Malaysian startups. Startups access the capital indirectly by raising from a Penjana Kapital-backed fund manager rather than applying directly.
programmes.deadline_note: Fund manager selection rounds are periodic; startups engage with the selected fund managers on those managers' own timelines.

procedure_steps.detail: Identify Penjana Kapital-backed fund managers from the Penjana Kapital website.
Pitch directly to the relevant fund manager.
Standard VC diligence and investment process.

eligibility.other_note: Malaysian startups raising venture capital. Investment decisions are made by the private fund managers, not by Penjana Kapital.

programmes.source_snippet: Penjana Kapital manages Dana Penjana Nasional, a matching fund programme to catalyse venture capital investment in Malaysia.
